matchById.recapBody: [{"type":"header","children":[{"type":"text","value":"The Bay rolls in inaugural TGL match against New York GC"}],"style":"h2","format":{"text-align":" center"}},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"The Bay Golf Club's Shane Lowry, with the honor of the first shot in TGL presented by SoFi history, forgot to bring a tee to the hitting area. Following a laugh and a deep breath, the Irishman launched his tee shot into the massive Screen, safely into the fairway, setting the inaugural season in motion Tuesday under the lights of SoFi Center in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Lowry would go on to record the clinching point for The Bay Golf Club over New York Golf Club, besting Rickie Fowler in Singles at the par-5 10"},{"type":"text","value":"th","format":{"variants":["superscript"]}},{"type":"text","value":" to make it 7-1 and secure the victory for himself and teammates Wyndham Clark and Ludvig Åberg with five holes left. The remaining holes were played out for a final score of 9-2."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"“It’s the most fun we’ve had playing golf,” Clark said."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"NYGC (0-1) fell behind on the first hole with Fowler, Xander Schauffele and Matt Fitzpatrick looking on as Åberg drained a nine-foot birdie putt at The Plank for the early 1-0 lead. It was that kind of night for NY Golf Club, which found itself on the wrong side of an early two-point swing."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"TBGC (1-0) began the match with the Hammer and held onto it for the first two holes. Then, with Clark feeling confident standing over a 7-foot birdie putt to win the par-3 third hole, Set in Stone, TBGC threw the Hammer to increase the point value of the hole to two points and show how quickly it can change the momentum in a match. "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"NYGC accepted and Clark drained the putt to give TBGC a 3-0 lead through three holes in a raucous environment that even the team on the receiving end appreciated."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"\"Set (the result aside), it was really cool walking into an arena and doing what we got to do there,” Fowler said. “We all wish it would have went a bit differently, but this is something fun.”"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"TBGC continued grinding out points with steady play and several spectacular highlights from Åberg. The 25-year-old Swede helped earn another point at the fourth hole, Boomerang, hitting his team’s third shot into the 582-yard par 5 to just four feet. Lowry made the birdie putt to put TBGC ahead, 4-0."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Åberg tacked on another at the par-3 fifth hole, Craic On, draining a 32-foot birdie putt to win the hole and make it 5-0 TBGC with 10 holes to play. "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Åberg and his teammates remained extremely poised throughout the night, even with the 40-second shot clock winding down in key moments. Lowry thinks that unique element could give TBGC an edge all season."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"“We’re probably three of the quicker players,” Lowry said. “I imagine (the shot clock is) going to be quite difficult for some people.”"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"TBGC won its fourth consecutive hole with a stress-free par at the sixth, but NYGC finished strong in Triples thanks to a crafty chip from Fitzpatrick at The Spear, the par-5 ninth hole. That resulted in a conceded birdie and the first point on the board for NYGC with the score 6-1 entering Singles."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"TBGC earns two points in the SoFi Cup Standings with the victory, while NY Golf Club will look to pick up its first points of the season in the next match."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"NYGC returns to action at 7 p.m. on Jan. 21 against Atlanta Drive Golf Club, while The Bay looks to keep it rolling with two matches on Feb. 17 against Atlanta Drive (4 p.m.) and Boston Common Golf (7 p.m.) as part of a TGL presented by SoFi tripleheader. "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Tuesday night’s star can’t wait to get back in the mix."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"“I think it’s really cool to be in a crowded environment where people are literally on top of you, screaming,” Åberg said. “I’m definitely looking forward to playing more of these so I can experience more of that this season.”"}]}]

recapTopVideo.shortDescription: The Bay Golf Club got the first win of the inaugural TGL presented by SoFi season with a 9-2 victory over New York Golf Club.
